_comment: Machine-readable record of the manifest version and date at which each clinical safety document was last formally reviewed and signed off by the Clinical Safety Officer (CSO). Update this file — not check-doc-versions.js — whenever a CSO review is completed. The check script reads these entries to compute 'minor releases behind' and escalate accordingly.
_comment_pending: last_cso_review_version/date record SIGNED reviews only. A doc change made between reviews is recorded in that doc's 'notes' prefixed 'PENDING CSO REVIEW (date):' and does NOT move last_cso_review_version — a pending change is not a review. A null last_cso_review_version means the document has never been formally CSO-reviewed.

incremental_reviews.scope: Sign-off of the doc-3.50 increment only (PR #353, grundyn, merged 2026-08-30 as v3.253.2 with follow-up 1532e4f): (a) the contacts-canvas wrong-type phone flag on open, and (b) the new biologic / monoclonal-antibody high-risk-unmatched class. (a) is NOT a new write path — it is the existing W18 change-telephone-number contract, so no section 6.1 row changes. Verified against code at review: the fix is click-only per flagged number with no automatic write, refuses to start while any other canvas write is in flight (wrongTypePhoneFixing joins anyWriteInFlight), re-derives page identity via resolveContext() before the read AND again immediately before the POST (H-043 / H-056), builds the full-replace body from a fresh getEditTelephoneNumber read resolving the write-side type value from the authoritative telephoneNumberTypes list rather than assuming the read-side label, and re-fetches the patient's numbers after the write instead of patching cached state so a failed or partial change cannot leave an optimistic 'fixed' row (H-056 control (h)). The on-screen claim stays a data-quality observation (H-056 control (j)). (b) verified by independent probe of the shipped stem list, not only the PR's own tests: the class fires across the listed rheumatology, dermatology, respiratory, gastroenterology, neurology, bone and oncology agents and on systemic IV bevacizumab, and does NOT fire on intravitreal / intravitreous / ophthalmic bevacizumab or licensed bevacizumab gamma (Lytenava), so AMD eye injections are not misread as needing shared-care bloods; JAK inhibitors are correctly absent from a class labelled 'monoclonal antibody'; denosumab accepted as a backstop only since denosumab-calcium already matches it. Residual gaps recorded and accepted as non-blocking, all in the fail-safe under-flagging direction on what is itself a backstop whose absence asserts nothing (limitation 22): brand-only systemic names with no generic stem (e.g. Avastin) do not match; the stem list is explicit so tezepelumab, tralokinumab, lebrikizumab, brodalumab and romosozumab do not fire; and the ophthalmic excludes are class-wide rather than bevacizumab-scoped, inert today because no other stem in the class has an intravitreal or ophthalmic UK form. All 405 repository tests pass at the reviewed commit. Incremental only — not a re-baseline, and last_cso_review_version deliberately does NOT move. Signed: Dr D. Triska (CSO, GMC 6159481), in session, 2026-08-31.

Sign-off of the doc-3.46 and doc-3.47 increments only (PR #351, grundyn, merged 2026-08-29 as v3.251.6 with follow-up 4f0c086 as v3.251.7): the 'ointment' / 'cream' / 'protopic' exclude applied to the five vaccine 'immunosuppressive medication' eligibility clauses in rules/vaccine-rules.json and to the DMARD/immunosuppressant class in the high-risk unmatched-medication backstop in engine/rules-engine.js. The CKS basis is accepted — topical calcineurin inhibitors have not been observed to produce systemic concentrations comparable to systemic use, so topical tacrolimus carries neither the systemic-immunosuppression vaccine consideration nor the blood-monitoring need either check exists to catch someone missing. Verified at review by independent probe of the shipped rule data, not only the PR's own tests: topical tacrolimus (ointment, cream, Protopic, any case, licensed ointment or unlicensed cream special) confers eligibility on none of the five clauses and raises no monitoring backstop, while Tacrolimus 1mg capsules, modified-release capsules, oral suspension and IV concentrate still fire on all five clauses and on the backstop; every other match term in every excluded clause was probed in an oral form and none is suppressed; and no other stem in the DMARD class has a marketed UK topical/ointment/cream form, so the exclude cannot suppress a genuine systemic hit. Recorded residual, unchanged by this PR and non-blocking: brand-only systemic tacrolimus (Advagraf, Prograf) carries no generic stem and so matches neither the vaccine clauses nor the backstop — the documented brand-only limit of name-stem matching, in the fail-safe under-flagging direction. All 405 repository tests pass at the reviewed commit. Incremental only — not a re-baseline, and last_cso_review_version deliberately does NOT move. Signed: Dr D. Triska (CSO, GMC 6159481), in session, 2026-08-31.

incremental_reviews.scope: Register re-examined as part of the 2026-08-31 incremental CSO sign-off of PRs #351 and #353 (see the CLINICAL-SAFETY-NOTICE.md 3.251.7 and 3.253.2 entries). NO new hazard and NO control change is required by either PR, and the hazard log is therefore unmodified by this sign-off. Reasoning recorded: PR #351 narrows two existing name-matching checks (vaccine immunosuppression eligibility clauses; the H-002 high-risk unmatched-medication backstop) so that topical tacrolimus no longer fires — a reduction in false-positive prompting on a backstop whose absence already asserts nothing (limitation 22), with systemic tacrolimus verified unaffected, so no H-002 control weakens. PR #353's mAb class widens the same backstop additively. PR #353's contacts phone-type-on-open write introduces no new write path: it is the existing W18 change-telephone-number contract already covered by H-056, and the on-open path was verified to inherit controls (f) wrong-patient guard via resolveContext() re-checked immediately before the POST, (h) full-replace body built from a fresh getEditTelephoneNumber read with the type value resolved from the authoritative telephoneNumberTypes list plus a post-write re-fetch rather than an optimistic cache patch, (i) no double-fire (per-id wrongTypePhoneFixing set, and it joins anyWriteInFlight so it cannot interleave with another canvas write), and (j) the on-screen claim remains a data-quality observation, never a clinical one. OPEN FOLLOW-UP, recorded rather than silently left: H-056's control (h) and (i) text names fixPhoneType and phoneFixingType only, so it does not yet name the new on-open fixWrongTypePhone / wrongTypePhoneFixing path it now also describes; the register should be extended to name it at the next hazard-log sync. Incremental only — not a re-baseline; the product-version pin stays 3.202.0 and last_cso_review_version does NOT move. Signed: Dr D. Triska (CSO, GMC 6159481), in session, 2026-08-31.
